query: What precision/recall/F1 thresholds will make automatic extractors for pragmatic markers acceptable for automatic-only use versus requiring manual verification?

response.query: What precision/recall/F1 thresholds will make automatic extractors for pragmatic markers acceptable for automatic-only use versus requiring manual verification?
response.answer: Precision/recall/F1 thresholds of 90% or higher typically make automatic extractors for pragmatic markers acceptable for automatic-only use. Lower thresholds may require manual verification.
